title: Prepared SCHC sender capabilities are unbounded and never expire
description: Security review: every caller-retained prepared sender lives in a WeakValueDictionary with no count or TTL; max_records applies only at start, and prepared senders can indefinitely block a replacement key during rotation. Add bounded prepared capacity plus monotonic lease expiry/cancellation under the security lock; admission failure must not disturb active state. Test load, exact expiry boundaries, and rotation.
